title: In nested CALCULATE an inner KEEPFILTERS intersects with the outer filter on the same column
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], KEEPFILTERS ( Customer[Country] IN { "US", "JP" } ) ), Customer[Country] IN { "JP", "FR" } ) )

source.quote: Because the intersection of filters is used
source.supports: the page's '$$ in WA !!' expression: with KEEPFILTERS the inner and outer filters on the column are intersected

source.quote: whereas CALCULATE filters replace the current context, KEEPFILTERS adds filters to the current context
source.supports: KEEPFILTERS adds to the current context instead of replacing it

derivation: Outer: { JP, FR }. Inner with KEEPFILTERS: { US, JP }. Intersection: JP = rows 5, 6 = 200 + 30 = 230. Without KEEPFILTERS the inner filter would replace the outer: US + JP = 540.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
